sources: Jaws of the Lion Learn to Play Guide
Jaws of the Lion Rules Glossary

steps.text: Open the Scenario Book to your scenario; read the introduction and special rules
steps.note: Player count here means the number of characters

steps.text: Scenario level = average character level / 2, rounded up{adj}
steps.note: It sets monster level, trap damage, gold per money token and bonus XP

steps.text: Money tokens, treasure tiles and traps as shown in the scenario key
steps.ref: Learn to Play p.25, Glossary p.12

steps.text: Element board with all 6 element tokens on Inert
Each player: character mat, attack modifier deck (with perks) and HP dial set for your level
Choose ability cards up to your hand limit (top right of your mat)
Shuffle the battle goals; deal {n} to each character, keep 1 in secret
Character figures on the starting hexes (one per hex); initiative tokens in the middle
For each monster type in the key: stat card in a sleeve showing the scenario level; initiative token
steps.ref: Learn to Play p.4, Glossary p.13

steps.text: Shuffle each monster's full 8-card ability deck
Starting room: place standees using the {n}-character row (black = none, white = normal, gold = elite)
Monsters in a room are set up only when its door opens, and act that round
steps.ref: Learn to Play p.14, Glossary p.17

steps.text: Spawned monsters appear at their spawn point (or nearest empty hex) and act that round
steps.ref: Learn to Play p.25, Glossary p.19

steps.text: Elements wane each round end: Strong, then Waning, then Inert
Everyone secretly picks 2 ability cards and sets one as the initiative card
Reveal one ability card per monster type; act in initiative order, lowest first
